title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Sênior
description:
Se você busca novos desafios e deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e inovador, essa oportunidade é para você! Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Salesforce apaixonado por tecnologia e soluções de CRM, que queira contribuir com seu conhecimento e crescer junto com a nossa equipe.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver e apoiar atividades de modelagem de dados no ambiente Salesforce, incluindo criação de objetos, campos e processos automatizados (flows, workflows, validation rules, process builders);
  • Realizar desenvolvimento em Salesforce (classes, triggers, coberturas de código e serviços web para integração);
  • Apoiar a gestão de arquitetura de dados com interface ao Salesforce Marketing Cloud;
  • Definir, desenvolver, testar, documentar e implementar novas soluções e integrações, alinhadas à governança e regras de negócio;
  • Entender fluxos ponta a ponta envolvendo sistemas satélites e outros squads;
  • Implementar as melhores práticas de código, design patterns, orientação a objetos e otimização de performance;
  • Desenvolver código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção;
  • Participar do processo de code review, garantindo qualidade e consistência do código;
  • Atuar com conhecimentos específicos da plataforma Salesforce, alinhado aos princípios de qualidade do CoE (Centro Operacional de Excelência em Salesforce) e políticas de governança;
  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis com o time (Daily, Review e Planning), aplicando metodologia ágil (SCRUM) no fluxo de trabalho.


O que esperamos de você?


Conhecimentos técnicos obrigatórios:

  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com criação e manutenção de Apex, incluindo Triggers, Apex Batches, Schedulers, Test Classes, DataFactory, bem como com padrões de projeto (Service, Helper, TriggerHandler, Wrapper) e boas práticas.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com Lightning Web Components, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de componentes.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com ferramentas declarativas, como Process Builder, Salesforce Flow, regras de validação, processos de aprovação, fluxos, gatilhos de fluxo e alertas de e-mail.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com configuração de segurança e administração, abrangendo controle de segurança, criação de layouts, tipos de registros, perfis, painéis, relatórios, usuários, funções, grupos, filas, permission sets e permission sets groups, sempre seguindo boas práticas.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com desenvolvimento end-to-end, incluindo levantamento de necessidades, implantação, implementação, testes e homologação.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com Sales Cloud ou Service Cloud.
  • Requerida experiência com data modeling e data management no ambiente Salesforce.
  • Requerida experiência com ordem de execução de Triggers (Triggers and Orders of Execution).
  • Requerida experiência com debug logs e Developer Console.
  • Requerida experiência com Apex Testing.
  • Requerida experiência com integrações e desenvolvimento em Apex e .NET Basics.
  • Requerida experiência com Platform Development basics.
  • Requerida experiência com Lightning Experience Development.
  • Requerida experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD (ex.: Flosum, Git).


Diferenciais que podem te destacar:

  • Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharia de sistemas ou Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Certificação Salesforce de Administrador/ Desenvolvedor/ Platform App Builder I;
  • Experiência com Salesforce e Salesforce Marketing Cloud;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Lean, Kanban, SAFe etc.);
  • Experiência com indicadores de CRM;
  • Experiência com modelo arquitetural REST/SOAP;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Experiência com o mercado Segurador, Previdenciário e/ou Financeiro.


Habilidades comportamentais que valorizamos:

  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração;
  • Comprometimento e engajamento;
  • Comunicação eficaz e organização;
  • Disciplina e foco;
  • Raciocínio lógico e resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade e aprendizado contínuo.


Por que se juntar ao nosso time?

  • Ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de aprendizado e desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Cultura de colaboração e crescimento conjunto;
  • Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta.


Modelo de contratação: PJ

Jornada: 168 horas/mês


Se identificou com essa oportunidade? Então, não perca tempo! Envie seu currículo e venha construir sua história com a gente!

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (CI & PM)
description:
Company Description

Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.

Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.


Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.


Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.

Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.

Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.

Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.

Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.

Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.

Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.

Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.


Qualifications

Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.

Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.

Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.

Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.

Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Senior/Lead QA Consultant – Loyalty & Marketing Automation (Independent Contractor) - 6 to 9 months (renewable)
description:
Keyrus is an international consulting firm, specializing in the integration of data intelligence and Digital solutions. With over 3200 employees spread across 28 countries, Keyrus continues to deliver on such projects to a wide range of clients from various industries including but not limited to Banking/Finance, Healthcare/pharmaceuticals, FMCG, Oil & Gas, and more.


As part of Keyrus’ solution delivery, we are also in a position to recruit and place technical consultants to complement on existing client projects with their expertise. As such, we seek innovative and agile people to support ambitious and forthcoming technological challenges


About The Role


We are seeking an experienced QA Lead Consultant based in Brazil, Sao Paulo to support a large-scale transformation program within the retail sector. The role is responsible for leading QA activities across multiple squads.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in complex, multi-system projects and is comfortable operating in fast-paced, cross-functional environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate QA activities across multiple development teams
  • Own end-to-end (E2E) testing readiness , ensuring alignment across systems and stakeholders
  • Oversee test data preparation and validation across systems
  • Manage defect lifecycle : triage, prioritization, and resolution follow-up with dev teams
  • Provide clear reporting on QA progress, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders

Requirements

  • Direct experience with Zephyr
  • Proven experience as a QA Lead / Test Lead in large-scale, complex projects
  • Hands-on experience with E2E testing coordination across multiple teams/systems
  • Solid experience in defect management and QA governance
  • Ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders in fast-paced delivery environments
  • Experience working in Agile / distributed team setups

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CRM platforms and loyalty/marketing systems
  • Prior exposure to retail or omnichannel environments

description:
Keyrus is an international consulting firm, specializing in the integration of data intelligence and Digital solutions. With over 3200 employees spread across 28 countries, Keyrus continues to deliver on such projects to a wide range of clients from various industries including but not limited to Banking/Finance, Healthcare/pharmaceuticals, FMCG, Oil & Gas, and more.


As part of Keyrus’ solution delivery, we are also in a position to recruit and place technical consultants to complement on existing client projects with their expertise. As such, we seek innovative and agile people to support ambitious and forthcoming technological challenges


About The Role


We are seeking an experienced QA Lead Consultant based in Brazil, Sao Paulo to support a large-scale transformation program within the retail sector. The role is responsible for leading QA activities across multiple squads.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in complex, multi-system projects and is comfortable operating in fast-paced, cross-functional environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate QA activities across multiple development teams
  • Own end-to-end (E2E) testing readiness , ensuring alignment across systems and stakeholders
  • Oversee test data preparation and validation across systems
  • Manage defect lifecycle : triage, prioritization, and resolution follow-up with dev teams
  • Provide clear reporting on QA progress, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders

Requirements

  • Direct experience with Zephyr
  • Proven experience as a QA Lead / Test Lead in large-scale, complex projects
  • Hands-on experience with E2E testing coordination across multiple teams/systems
  • Solid experience in defect management and QA governance
  • Ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders in fast-paced delivery environments
  • Experience working in Agile / distributed team setups

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CRM platforms and loyalty/marketing systems
  • Prior exposure to retail or omnichannel environments

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV


The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. This isn’t just maintenance; you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the \"Full Lifecycle Engineer\"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a \"Builder\" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.

title: Freelancer | AEM Content Author (Adobe Experience Manager)
description:
Buscamos um(a) AEM Content Author responsável pela publicação de conteúdos digitais no Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), garantindo consistência, qualidade e alinhamento com as diretrizes de marca e estratégia digital da empresa.

Esse profissional atuará em conjunto com times de marketing, UX/UI e tecnologia, sendo responsável por assegurar que os conteúdos sejam entregues com excelência, seguindo boas práticas de usabilidade, SEO e governança, além de contribuir para a evolução contínua da operação digital.


PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Criar, editar e publicar páginas, componentes e conteúdos no Adobe Experience Manager (AEM);
  • Gerenciar a estrutura de navegação, organização de páginas, taxonomia e metadados;
  • Garantir a correta aplicação de SEO on-page, acessibilidade e boas práticas de conteúdo;
  • Revisar conteúdos assegurando consistência visual, textual e aderência às diretrizes de marca;
  • Validar o comportamento das páginas em diferentes dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
  • Apoiar campanhas digitais, lançamentos de produtos e atualizações de conteúdo recorrentes;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de marketing, design, produto e tecnologia;
  • Realizar testes básicos antes da publicação (links, imagens, componentes, navegação);
  • Identificar e reportar inconsistências ou bugs, colaborando com times técnicos na resolução;
  • Apoiar a validação de novos componentes e funcionalidades dentro do AEM;
  • Contribuir para a organização e melhoria contínua dos processos de publicação e governança de conteúdo.

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência comprovada com Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) como Content Author;
  • Conhecimento em estrutura de páginas, templates e componentes no AEM;
  • Noções de HTML e CSS para entendimento de estrutura e ajustes básicos;
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de SEO e acessibilidade;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de design como Figma e Adobe Photoshop;
  • Perfil organizado, com atenção a detalhes e foco em qualidade;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar com times multidisciplinares.


DESEJÁVEL

  • Experiência com ferramentas do ecossistema Adobe, como Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Launch, Adobe Assets;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise como Google Analytics 4 (GA4) e Google Tag Manager (GTM);
  • Conhecimento em personalização de conteúdo e segmentação de audiência;
  • Experiência com CMS headless ou arquiteturas híbridas;
  • Experiência com CMS Wordpress, Drupal, Joomla ou similares;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de apoio à criação de conteúdo baseadas em AI, como ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly ou assistentes de escrita e otimização de conteúdo;
  • Noções de uso de AI para geração, revisão e otimização de conteúdo (SEO, copy, variações);
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


Vaga Freelancer

Pagamento por hora

Contrato PJ

Dedicação full time

title: Kronos Business Analyst
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!


For over 27 years , UST has worked alongside the world’s leading companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation.


Together, with more than 39,000 employees across 30 countries , we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role


The Kronos / UKG WFM Business Analyst is responsible for analyzing business requirements and supporting the implementation, configuration, upgrade, and integration of UKG Workforce Management solutions (formerly Kronos) .

The role works closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and project managers to ensure successful delivery of WFM solutions aligned with business and operational needs.



Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to Workforce Management (time & attendance, scheduling, labor rules, pay rules, etc.).
  • Translate business requirements into functional and technical design specifications.
  • Configure and support UKG Workforce Management platforms (UKG Pro WFM / Workforce Central).
  • Support end‑to‑end implementation, upgrades, and migrations from WFC to UKG Pro WFM.
  • Design, execute, and support functional testing, integration testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) .
  • Work closely with technical, integration, and offshore teams to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
  • Support data extraction, validation, and migration activities.
  • Coordinate with project managers to meet project milestones, timelines, and delivery commitments.
  • Provide training and knowledge transfer to business users and support teams.
  • Support post‑implementation activities and ongoing enhancements as required.
  • Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams.


Required Technical Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7–10+ years of experience working with Kronos / UKG Workforce Management solutions .
  • Strong experience with UKG Workforce Central and/or UKG Pro WFM .
  • Advanced English Level - B2 + - C1
  • Solid experience in requirements gathering and functional solution design.
  • Experience supporting system testing, integrations, and UAT.
  • Understanding of WFM modules such as Timekeeping, Scheduling, Pay Rules, Activities, and Reporting.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder and client‑facing skills.
  • Ability to work independently in complex environments.


Nice to have


  • Experience with integrations to HR or payroll systems (e.g., Workday, PeopleSoft).
  • Experience in system upgrades or consolidations.
  • Exposure to Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Multilingual skills (Spanish / Portuguese preferred for LATAM roles).


Conditions


  • Contractor - 5 months
  • 100 % remote
  • Colombia - Argentina - Chile or Brazil
  • Agile and highly collaborative technical environment.


We encourage you to apply or reach out for more information.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Solutions Architect – Sao Paulo / Hybrid - Fluent French & English

(Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, Software Implementation, Solutions Architecture, SaaS, Architecture, API Integrations, REST, Web Services, CRM, eCommerce, ERP, OMS, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant)


Our client is an exciting and cutting-edge fintech giant with a global presence. They have been a market leader within the fintech consultancy sector for many years and their worldwide client base has never been stronger, with significant growth in the last 12 months. They are looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to own the end-to-end solution design, implement their cloud-based space planning and design platforms and ensure solution integrity from discovery through deployment.


As an experienced Solutions Architect, you will be responsible for providing architectural oversight across multiple concurrent implementations and leading architectural discovery sessions with customer stakeholders. This will include designing end-to-end solution architectures across SaaS platforms, APIs, middleware, CRM, eCommerce, and Order Management systems.


Expert knowledge of cloud-based SaaS architecture and API integrations, such as REST and Web Services is essential, as experience leading enterprise-level software implementations. Experience working in multi-system ecosystems, such as CRM, eCommerce, ERP and OMS is also expected. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are a must, as you will be acting as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers and presenting solution designs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also need to have excellent time and priority management skills that enable you to work in different time zones and speak and write fluently in French and English.


We are keen to hear from talented Solutions Architect candidates from all backgrounds.


This is a truly amazing opportunity to work for a prestigious brand that will do wonders for your career. They invest heavily in training and career development; top performers are guaranteed a career path into senior and lead positions within 12 months.


Location: Sao Paulo / Hybrid

Salary: 160k BRL – 190k BRL + Bonus + Pension + Excellent Benefits

Languages: Fluent in French and English


To apply for this position please send your CV to Karan Gajjar at Noir Consulting.

title: Consultor (a) SAP SuccessFactors EC PL/SR
description:
Hr Path Group

O Grupo HR Path, um interveniente global na consultoria de RH, acompanha os seus clientes nos seus projetos de transformação de RH, tanto nos aspectos humanos como nas ferramentas (HRIS). Intervimos na Europa, América e Ásia-Pacífico, para as nossas grandes contas e clientes PME, a fim de lhes oferecer um apoio global no desenvolvimento da sua estratégia de RH.

Aconselhar para executar! HR Path, líder mundial em soluções de RH

  • Advise: Acompanhamos os nossos clientes na transformação da sua função de RH, através de uma redefinição da sua organização de RH e da digitalização do seu HRIS
  • Implement: Como parceiro dos principais editores do mercado, realizamos projetos de implementação técnica e funcional de todas as soluções HRIS (SaaS ou On-Premise)
  • Run: Graças à nossa experiência global em processamento de salários, oferecemos aos nossos clientes vários níveis de externalização de salários.


O que estamos buscando:

Profissional fará parte do time de consultores funcionais do Sistema SuccessFactors módulo Employee Central, e irá atuar na implementação de projetos, melhorias ou suporte.

Deve ter o conhecimento no software em questão, além de um perfil voltado ao pensamento crítico e solução de problemas com grande atenção aos detalhes. Como o suporte ao usuário final e o trabalho em equipe são aspectos importantes do papel, são necessárias excelentes habilidades de comunicação e de pessoas e também deve ter excelentes habilidades de organização.


Atividades a serem desenvolvidas:

  • Atuar em projetos de implementação do Employee Central e Benefícios, projetos de melhorias e no atendimento de suporte a clientes (AMS);
  • Treinar usuários finais, incluindo profissionais de RH, sobre como usar o SuccessFactors Employee Central e quaisquer funcionalidades relacionadas.
  • Identificar e sugerir melhorias no sistema com base no feedback dos usuários e na evolução das necessidades de negócios.
  • Treinar e capacitar pessoas da equipe no módulo Employee Central;
  • Colaborar com equipes internas e fornecedores para implementar as soluções propostas;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as últimas liberações e produtos da SAP que envolvem o SuccessFactors Employee Central.


O que oferecemos:

  • Um ambiente de trabalho estimulante no seio de uma cultura empreendedora e internacional
  • Uma abordagem transversal das nossas atividades, que favorece o trabalho em equipe e a excelência
  • Numerosas oportunidades de progressão (mobilidade horizontal, vertical e internacional)
  • Múltiplas oportunidades de formação (universidade interna, certificações)
  • Certificado Happy at Work, oferecemos um bom equilíbrio de vida com possibilidades de teletrabalho
  • Um ambiente de trabalho amigável (atividades de equipe trimestrais, seminário internacional anual)


Nos vemos em breve na HR Path!

title: CRO Expert — DTC Ecommerce
description:
⛔If you have no experience with DTC stores in the US, UK or European markets, this role is not for you.


CRO Expert — DTC E-commerce (Shopify · Landing Pages · AI) | 100% Remote


We’re not looking for someone who simply manages tools. We’re looking for someone who understands why people buy — and knows how to change that.


You’ll work on DTC brands with real traffic and an active budget. Every test you run has a direct impact on revenue. No internal projects with no consequences — here, the data is the boss.

AI isn’t optional — we expect it to already be part of your daily workflow.


Remuneration:


Competitive fixed base salary based on experience + direct bonus linked to actual conversion uplift. Career path with direct share in the results of the brands you optimise. The more impact you generate, the greater your share in the results. 100% remote with flexible hours.



✅ Only applies if:


3+ years as a CRO Specialist in DTC shops on Shopify — with documented and verifiable uplift cases

Experience with brands in the US or UK markets with active operations (essential)

Proficiency in A/B testing with statistical rigour: VWO, Convert or Optimizely — not just “it seems to have worked”

Advanced GA4: events, funnels and attribution configured from scratch without relying on anyone

HTML, CSS and JS to implement and launch tests independently without relying on developers

English C1+

Active use of AI as a daily production tool, not as an experiment

Speak English or Spanish/ Both


⭐ We particularly value:


Experience in the health, beauty or CPG sectors

Understanding of LTV, CAC and unit economics — you optimise for profitability, not just conversion rates

Optimisation in Spanish and English, with cultural sensitivity in both markets

Hotjar / Clarity · Lifetimely / Triple Whale

Knowledge of Shopify page builders: Replo, Shogun, Zipify or others

Spanish High Level

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background building AI native software to join our U.S. client. You will provide leadership and expertise to advance strategic and technical goals of our client.

Our client is a venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI-native software solving real-world problems as well as consulting services to propel software companies along their AI journey.


Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic and technical expertise to AI-powered, engineering initiatives
  • Advise startups on AI product development using agentic AI, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Develop software in conjunction with startup subject matter experts and engineering teams
  • Stay abreast of AI trends and advise colleagues and clients on emerging AI opportunities
  • Communicate across different stakeholder groups including executive, boards, technical, client and industry


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of software development experience including AI engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Python
  • Deep experience in AI product development using agents, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and deliver in a vibrant, fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field
  • Experience with AWS


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Growth Marketing Analyst
description:
About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.


We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy, and that's how we communicate too.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is growing and we need someone to build and run the marketing infrastructure that supports it. As a Growth Marketing Analyst, you'll work across three fronts — recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition —designing strategies, setting up campaigns, configuring tools and measuring what converts. Your primary focus is on capture and expansion (website, CRM, events, paid media, referral systems, client retention), while supporting the demand layer fed by content and authority.


This role works in close partnership with leadership and sales. You'll think about where to invest and how to grow, then make it happen, connecting marketing efforts to pipeline, testing what works, cutting what doesn't and scaling what proves itself.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Channel oversight & growth

  • Set and track channel-level goals aligned with Downtown's growth priorities: recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition
  • Own the day-to-day management and growth of marketing channels — email, paid media, outbound, events and future channels
  • Plan, execute and optimize paid campaigns, including budget management and audience targeting
  • Support the design and execution of outbound and ABM initiatives
  • Optimize website performance as a conversion engine — landing pages, CTAs, user flow and lead capture
  • Monitor organic search performance and identify SEO opportunities to support inbound growth
  • Propose and test new campaigns, formats and acquisition strategies to improve performance


2.CRM & automation

  • Own the marketing layer of the CRM (Zoho) in partnership with sales: segmentation, audience lists, campaign tagging and marketing lifecycle tracking
  • Handle the technical setup and configuration of marketing platforms and integrations
  • Build and manage email marketing flows — nurture sequences, newsletters, re-engagement campaigns and event-driven communications


3.Reporting & optimization

  • Track and report on channel performance, campaign results and growth metrics
  • Run experiments, analyze data and translate findings into actionable improvements
  • Monitor referral and client retention metrics, supporting sales with data-driven insights


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Analytical mindset with comfort in data, dashboards and performance reporting
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Experience with B2B marketing and demand generation
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar)
  • Experience building and managing email marketing flows and automation
  • Hands-on experience with paid media (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads or similar platforms)


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM)
  • Experience with marketing automation tools beyond email (e.g., workflow builders, lead scoring)
  • Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction industry


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  • Technical challenge
  • Interviews with leadership
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: AI Video Producer (VEO3) for YouTube Ad Creative Agency
description:
About Us

We are a performance driven YouTube ad creative agency focused on producing high converting video ads for ecommerce brands.

Our team combines direct response strategy with cutting edge AI production workflows to create scalable video assets that drive measurable results.

We move fast, test aggressively, and continuously iterate on creative performance. Our focus is not on aesthetics alone, but on producing video content that converts and scales profitably.

We operate as a small, high performance team built around speed, ownership, and results.


Role Overview

We are hiring an AI Video Producer who specializes in generating high quality video content using AI tools such as VEO3, Kling, Heygen, and similar platforms.

You will be responsible for translating creative briefs into raw video assets by crafting effective prompts, iterating on outputs, and delivering production ready footage for our YouTube ad campaigns.

This role requires strong prompting skills, creative intuition, and the ability to consistently produce high quality outputs at scale.

You will work closely with creative strategists, editors, and AI workflows to bring ad concepts to life efficiently.


Key Responsibilities

Craft high quality prompts for VEO3, Kling, Heygen, and similar AI video tools to generate compelling video clips.

Produce raw video footage that aligns with creative briefs and direct response messaging.

Iterate on AI generated outputs to refine quality, consistency, and performance.

Translate written scripts and concepts into visual scenes using AI tools.

Collaborate with creative strategists and editors to ensure alignment on direction and deliverables.

Stay up to date with the latest AI video tools, prompting techniques, and workflows.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality.

Optimize workflows to increase output efficiency and scalability.


Qualifications and Requirements

Experience using AI video tools such as VEO, Kling, Heygen, Runway, or similar.

Strong prompting ability with a clear understanding of how to control output quality and style.

Good visual sense and understanding of storytelling, pacing, and scene composition.

Ability to follow creative briefs and translate them into accurate visual outputs.

Experience working in a fast paced, performance driven environment.

Highly self directed with strong attention to detail.

Comfortable working with iterative workflows and rapid testing cycles.

Basic understanding of direct response marketing is a strong advantage.


Preferred Skills and Bonuses

Experience producing video creatives for YouTube or paid social ads.

Understanding of direct response frameworks and ad structures.

Experience working with ecommerce brands.

Familiarity with AI workflow automation and tools.

Experience collaborating with editors and creative teams.


What We Offer

Fully remote position.

Consistent workload with ongoing projects.

Opportunity to work with cutting edge AI tools.

Fast paced environment with rapid learning.

Clear growth path as the agency scales.

Performance driven culture focused on output and results.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Quem somos:

Prezensa, uma empresa de tecnologia com foco em pessoas e compromisso real com resultados.

Nascemos da fusão de três consultorias com mais de 10 anos de trajetória (ESX, DevLand e Squad Premium) para criar um novo modelo no setor: mais humano, mais presente, mais estratégico.

Fomos pioneiros ao lançar a primeira PeopleTech do Brasil, unindo excelência técnica com acompanhamento próximo, de ponta a ponta.

Aqui, cada profissional é acompanhado, cada cliente é ouvido e cada entrega tem propósito.

Nossa cultura é baseada em transparência, colaboração e inovação. Valorizamos a autonomia e o desenvolvimento contínuo de nossos talentos.


Você se identifica com esse propósito? Então, o seu futuro é na Prezensa.

  • Flow e Process Builder;
  • Code Review;
  • Padrões e guidelines de desenvolvimento;
  • Testes unitários e funcionais;

title: Analista SAP Basis - Security
description:
A Softtek está em busca de um(a) Analista SAP Basis Security - Sênior para fazer parte do nosso quadro de colaboradores e atuar em um ambiente global e desafiador.


Conhecimentos/Experiências que a pessoa precisa ter:

• Segurança em SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA (módulos BC, HR, PM, MM, FICO, etc.).

• Segurança em Fiori.

• Segurança em SuccessFactors.

• Segurança em CyberArk (gestão de acessos privilegiados).

• Gestão de ferramentas de ciclo de vida: SAP Solution Manager (SolMan) e Azure DevOps.

• Avaliação e acompanhamento da remediação de vulnerabilidades.

• Segurança de redes e infraestrutura de TI.

• Conhecimentos gerais de redes: TCP/IP e modelo OSI.

• Administração de sistemas operacionais: Linux, Unix e Windows.

• Gestão e administração de aplicações de infraestrutura Microsoft.

• Conhecimentos em Microsoft Active Directory e Exchange.

• Conhecimentos em servidores Windows, Linux e Unix.

• Conhecimentos em Exchange, Office 365 e Azure.

• Domínio avançado de Microsoft Office.

• Conhecimentos básicos em bancos de dados: SQL Server, Oracle e Access.

• Conhecimentos básicos de programação: ABAP, ASP, HTML, Visual Script, JavaScript e PowerShell.

• Gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM).

• Conhecimentos em criptografia e PKI.

title: Analista Funcional Salesforce Sênior
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) profissional com experiência em Salesforce e forte visão de processos comerciais para atuar na modelagem, configuração e evolução de soluções dentro da plataforma. Essa pessoa será responsável por conectar as necessidades do negócio com a implementação técnica, garantindo eficiência e aderência funcional nas entregas.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Modelar processos comerciais no Salesforce (B, P, R, A, L)
  • Construir e configurar fluxos, regras de negócio, layouts, perfis de acesso, permissões e automações na plataforma
  • Validar User Stories (US) junto às áreas de negócio, garantindo clareza, entendimento e aderência funcional
  • Atuar como ponte entre as áreas de negócio e tecnologia na definição de soluções
  • Apoiar integrações funcionais com sistemas como SAP e Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), assegurando consistência dos processos ponta a ponta
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planning, daily, review, retrospectiva) e acompanhar entregas com times técnicos e funcionais


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência com configuração e customização no Salesforce
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de processos comerciais (funil de vendas, gestão de contas, oportunidades, etc.)
  • Experiência com criação de fluxos (Flow), validações e automações
  • Vivência na construção e validação de User Stories
  • Experiência em integração funcional com sistemas corporativos (ex: SAP, OTM ou similares)
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em projetos de integração entre Salesforce e SAP
  • Conhecimento em processos logísticos (OTM)
  • Certificações Salesforce (Admin, Sales Cloud, etc.)
  • Experiência em ambientes com múltiplos stakeholders

  • Work Mode: Remote

  • Daily Commitment: 5–6 hours
  • Pay Rate: $4 per hour

  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.


Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: High School Graduate (or higher) .
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .


Next Steps: Evaluation Process

To proceed with your application, please complete the following assessments:

1️⃣ Assessment Test

Assesses your linguistic and analytical skills.


LLM Evaluation Test:

✅ Once both assessments are successfully completed, you’ll be eligible for onboarding and background verification .

title: .NET Developer
description:
Job Title:

Mid-Level .NET Developer (Backend / Distributed Systems)


Overview

We are seeking a mid-level .NET Developer to join a backend-focused engineering team building and enhancing distributed services in AWS. This role is heavily backend and API-driven, with a strong emphasis on asynchronous processing, system-to-system integration, and resilient service design. The engineer will work on both net-new services and enhancements to existing systems, collaborating closely with product owners and other engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and enhance backend services using .NET and C#

• Develop RESTful APIs and backend components that operate within distributed systems

• Build and maintain asynchronous processing workflows using messaging patterns

• Upgrade and modernize existing .NET applications (e.g. .NET 8 to .NET 10)

• Implement system-to-system integrations, including external-facing services

• Consume and process messages from event-driven sources, handling retries and failure scenarios

• Participate in unit and integration testing as part of CI/CD pipelines

• Deploy services to Kubernetes environments in AWS

• Collaborate with product owners, engineers, and cross-functional teams in a ticket-driven environment

• Contribute to design discussions with a system-wide, not just code-level, mindset


Technical Requirements

• Strong proficiency with C# and modern .NET development

• Experience building backend services and RESTful APIs

• Solid understanding of distributed systems and asynchronous processing

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures (pub/sub, messaging systems)

• Experience working in AWS environments

• Familiarity with Kubernetes-based deployments (e.g. EKS)

• Experience using relational databases (e.g. AWS RDS)

• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions

• Experience with unit testing and integration testing in .NET applications


Preferred / Nice to Have

• Experience with AWS messaging services such as SNS and SQS

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform

• Experience deploying applications via GitHub Actions

• Exposure to configuration management patterns (e.g. externalized config services)

• Experience working alongside teams using different technology stacks (e.g. Clojure or functional programming environments)

• Familiarity with authentication and service-to-service security (e.g. Okta)

• Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot


Work Environment & Team Culture

• Backend-heavy role with minimal frontend expectations

• Collaborative, low-micromanagement engineering culture

• Engineers are expected to work independently but ask questions when needed

• Ticket-driven work with varying levels of requirement detail

• Strong emphasis on respectful cross-team collaboration

• Encouragement of thoughtful technical pushback and design discussions

• Regular pairing and open communication via Slack and ad-hoc calls

• Focus on sustainable delivery rather than perfection under time constraints


What Success Looks Like

• Quickly ramping into existing systems and development patterns

• Owning backend services end to end, from design through deployment

• Demonstrating a strong systems mindset beyond individual features

• Building reliable, maintainable services within a distributed architecture

• Collaborating effectively across teams with different technical bac

title: Consultor SAP SD - AMS
description:
A Softtek está em busca de Consultor SAP SD Sênior para apoiar o AMS de um de nossos grandes clientes.


Conhecimentos/Experiências que a pessoa precisa ter:

  • Sólida experiência funcional em SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) em nível sênior
  • Vivência consistente em processos comerciais, gestão de pedidos, faturamento, entregas e devoluções
  • Experiência prática com cenários comerciais G, H, I, Q, U e S
  • Conhecimento avançado em configuração de Pricing e Crédito
  • Experiência com configuração, suporte e monitoramento de EDI (linha e sazonal)
  • Vivência em integrações entre SAP e Salesforce
  • Conhecimento em integrações via Middleware , APIs e troubleshooting de interfaces
  • Experiência atuando em ambiente ágil, com entregas em Sprints
  • Capacidade de análise de impacto e priorização de demandas
  • Perfil consultivo, com boa comunicação entre negócio, TI e parceiros externos
  • Experiência em suporte a incidentes e melhorias contínuas no módulo SD
  • Visão end to end dos processos comerciais e suas integrações
  • Forte atenção aos detalhes, senso de urgência e confiabilidade nas entregas


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar, sustentar e ajustar processos comerciais no SAP SD , contemplando cenários G, H, I, Q, U e S
  • Configurar e manter regras de Pricing e Crédito
  • Atuar na configuração, suporte e sustentação de EDI (linha e sazonal)
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos fluxos de integração entre Salesforce e SAP
  • Validar integrações com Middleware , identificando falhas e propondo ajustes quando necessário
  • Realizar ajustes em regras SAP dentro de ciclos ágeis de entrega (Sprints )
  • Apoiar na resolução de incidentes e implementação de melhorias relacionadas aos processos de SAP SD
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times funcionais e técnicos, garantindo a visão end to end dos processos comerciais e integrações

Horário de Trabalho: 9h às 18h

title: Arquiteto de Soluções Sênior (SAP + Salesforce)
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções Sênior com forte experiência em ecossistemas SAP e Salesforce , responsável por desenhar, evoluir e governar arquiteturas de integração complexas, garantindo alta performance, segurança e escalabilidade das soluções.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de integrações entre SAP , SuccessFactors (SF) , Salesforce , Middleware e OTM (Oracle Transportation Management)
  • Garantir padrões técnicos, boas práticas de desenvolvimento, segurança, performance e escalabilidade
  • Apoiar decisões técnicas críticas envolvendo EDI, Pricing, Mobile e integrações logísticas (OTM)
  • Atuar na governança técnica dos projetos, assegurando consistência entre as soluções implementadas
  • Acompanhar dependências técnicas e integrações entre squads ao longo das Sprints
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times funcionais, técnicos e stakeholders de negócio
  • Definir e manter diretrizes de arquitetura para integrações entre SF, SAP e Middleware/OTM
  • Garantir alinhamento técnico entre diferentes frentes e projetos simultâneos


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Arquiteto(a) de Soluções em ambientes complexos
  • Vivência comprovada com integrações entre SAP e Salesforce
  • Conhecimento em SuccessFactors (SF) e integrações com SAP
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Middleware (ex: PI/PO, CPI, MuleSoft ou similares)
  • Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de integração (APIs, mensageria, EDI, etc.)
  • Experiência com integrações logísticas e/ou OTM
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança, performance e escalabilidade de sistemas
  • Experiência atuando em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com projetos globais ou ambientes multi-país
  • Certificações em SAP , Salesforce ou arquitetura (TOGAF, etc.)
  • Vivência com soluções de Pricing e Mobile
  • Experiência com governança técnica em ambientes com múltiplos squads

title: Analista de Negócios - Remoto (Time Internacional)
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:

Analista de Negócios - Remoto (Time Internacional)


O que oferecemos a você:

– Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

– Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

– Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

– Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

– Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

– Auxílio creche;

– Seguro de vida;

– Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

– Parceria com instituições de ensino;

– Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

– Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

– Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

– Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

– Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

– GetVibes – nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

  • Atuação em projeto internacional em uma empresa global da área da saúde;
  • Atuação 100% home office, em horário comercial.
  • Contratação CLT.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Inglês avançado.
  • Experiencia com atuação junto a área de negócios.
  • Experiência utilizando metodologia ágil (Ex: Scrum, Kanban).
  • Criar, descrever e organizar histórias técnicas para os projetos da área.
  • Apoiar a documentação e manutenção dos processos da área, fornecendo insights e acompanhando KPIs.
  • Facilidade para se comunicar com diversos stakeholders.
  • Bons conhecimentos de construção de business cases e business plans.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e ferramentas de acompanhamento de projetos (Ex: Jira, Azure).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiencia em empresas da área da saúde.
  • Certificação ágil.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
Title: Senior Technical Recruiter (Contractor / PJ)

Duration: 12 months (with potential extension)


Overview :

Our client is seeking a Senior Recruiter to support US-based clients in a fast-paced staffing environment. This role requires strong English communication, experience working directly with US stakeholders, and the ability to manage high-volume recruiting across multiple requisitions.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage full lifecycle recruiting (intake → sourcing → screening → submission → interview → offer → close)
  • Support US-based hiring managers and account teams
  • Handle high-volume req loads (20–40+ open roles depending on complexity)
  • Recruit across technical and/or professional roles
  • Work within ATS/VMS systems (including high-touch / low-touch / no-touch environments)
  • Maintain strong pipeline activity and candidate engagement
  • Ensure high-quality submissions with strong attention to detail


Requirements:

  • 5+ years recruiting experience (agency or staffing strongly preferred)
  • Track record of success in Technical Recruiting supporting roles like Software Engineer, DevOps, Solutions Architect, etc.
  • Proven experience supporting US-based clients
  • Strong English (spoken + written)
  • Experience with high-volume recruiting environments
  • Experience working with VMS / MSP models
  • Highly process-driven and organized
  • Supporting customers in the US EST Timezone


Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting Government or strict compliance accounts
  • Recruiting experience for Retail Operations and/or Creative positions (Graphic Design, Fashion Design, etc.)
  • Metrics-driven mindset (submittals, interviews, placements)

title: AI Art Director (Streetwear/Exotic Cars)
description:
So… what the hell is Ark Exotic?

Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet.


Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.


Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native art direct who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.


What You'll Do

  • Lead a team of designers to create visuals that stop scrolls
  • Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads
  • Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel)
  • Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders
  • Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars
  • Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demands


Who You Are

  • We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built.
  • You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before
  • You've mastered Freepik Spaces and Higgsfield
  • You understand the difference between \"looks expensive\" and \"feels exclusive\"
  • Your portfolio looks like an A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel
  • You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world
  • You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure
  • Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted.
  • You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster \"Hunt\" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brand


What We're Building

  • The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.
  • This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive salary based on your portfolio
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

  • A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language
  • A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaign


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

title: Tech - Delivery Manager
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


  • O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de entrega dos projetos Nearshore, garantindo padronização, documentação e aderência às práticas de governança da Dexian.
  • Realizar avaliações técnicas dos projetos (arquitetura, qualidade de código, automação, maturidade DevOps) e propor ações de melhoria com base em evidências.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs operacionais — velocity, throughput, defect density, taxa de conclusão de sprints, lead time.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com clientes US, conduzindo discussões técnicas e de performance com postura executiva.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os Delivery Managers e o SDM existentes, identificando bloqueios, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos times.
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros dos projetos (GP, utilização, aderência ao SOW) em parceria com Finanças/Ops.
  • Acompanhar satisfação e engajamento dos consultores alocados, identificando sinais de risco de attrition.
  • Apoiar o recrutamento na validação de fit técnico e senioridade de novos recursos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, QA automation ou DevOps, com pelo menos 2 anos em liderança técnica ou de delivery.
  • Profundidade técnica em pelo menos uma área (Cloud/APIs, automação de testes ou DevOps/observabilidade) e capacidade de avaliar criticamente as demais.
  • Experiência com métricas operacionais (KPIs, SLAs, produtividade).
  • Inglês avançado com postura executiva para reuniões com clientes.
  • Experiência com múltiplos projetos simultâneos e metodologias ágeis.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Vivência e acompanhamento de profissionais alocados


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime remoto.


Regime de Contratação CLT


Benefícios para você

* Vale Refeição

* Vale Alimentação

* Assistência Médica

* Assistência Odontológica

* Seguro de Vida

* Gym Pass

* Auxílio Pet


Além disso, oferecemos :

* Incentivo a estudo após completar 1 ano de Dexian

* Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos

* Formação através da Trilha de Liderança

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an (preferred), GCP, , or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake


Desired Experience


  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information


  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values


  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient


We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Job Title: AI Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Overview


We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, DevOps, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
  • Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows.
  • Build reusable patterns for:
  • AI-assisted code generation
  • Pull request automation
  • Test generation
  • Debugging workflows
  • Developer self-service enablement
  • Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Manage AI usage governance, including:
  • Token budgeting and cost controls
  • Usage monitoring and reporting
  • PII redaction guardrails
  • Audit logging and responsible AI practices
  • Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations.
  • Integrate AI tooling into GitLab CI/CD, GitOps workflows, and developer platforms .
  • Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings.
  • Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
  • Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/SaaS tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.
  • Practical daily usage of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT , or similar.
  • Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
  • Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
  • Bedrock
  • API Gateway
  • Managed AI/Cloud Services
  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, GitOps, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).
  • Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence .
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • LLM Agents
  • RAG pipelines
  • Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch, etc.)
  • LangChain / LlamaIndex
  • Exposure to AI FinOps , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.
